notes.title: Patch Feb. 3rd
notes.content:
We've pushed live a new patch that fixes the NSFW gallery as well as the character been invisible after entering the post-game.

Now when running with NSFW DLC on, you will be able to see the 20 entries on the image gallery.
Before the NSFW images replaced the SFW ones.
